nom: First Aid Beauty Ultra Repair Firming Day Cream

avis.texte: This product used to be my holy grail. I'm not sure when or why they switched the formula, but it now seems to have a menthol-y scent to it, and, it makes my skin burn almost immediately after putting it on. My skin is quite sensitive, so feeling frustrated and disappointed that I'll need to figure something else out. Hopefully the switch back? Splitting the firming cream it into a "day cream" and "night cream" feels like a money grab.

I I have very sensitive skin, and this product—paired with their dewy moisturizer—has completely restored my skin's health and cleared up my hyperpigmentation. (Note: I do use a different sunscreen primer.) While every skin type is different and sensitivities vary, this is a holy grail for me. Other products meant for sensitive skin usually break me out, but this doesn't. Please, please don't ever change the formula

The Ultra Repair Firming Cream from First Aid Beauty has been a game-changer for my complexion, and I have been using it for quite some time. My complexion is given a bouncy and young appearance thanks to the combination of peptides and niacinamide, which work together to smooth fine wrinkles. The product is not oily, it is lightweight, and it maintains a highly moisturized sensation on my skin. My skin appears to be more radiant and firmer after a few weeks of using this product, and I couldn't be happier with the results!

This cream has a rich, creamy texture that feels incredibly nourishing on my skin without being heavy or greasy. It absorbs beautifully, providing deep hydration while helping to brighten my complexion and reduce the appearance of fine lines. I also love the elegant glass jar packaging. Gifted by FAB.

I love this firming cream as a moisturizer. I definitely feel like my face is getting some much needed hydration and after using it for awhile, I am starting to finally see some light plumping action going on with my fine lines. This cream pairs well with my other skincare and my make-up. Highly recommend!

I have used the Firming Cream with Peptides, Niacinamide + Collagen from First Aid Beauty for 2 weeks now, the formula is a bit heavy for me. I have combination/dry skin and tend to like thinner, buildable creams. A little goes a long way with this product. However, I would recommend this to someone who has dry skin and needs extra hydration. The cream has a pleasant scent and comes in great packaging. This product was gifted in exchange for an honest review.

I used this cream off and on for a few weeks and overall liked how it makes my skin feel in the morning. It absorbs quickly and doesn't leave a greasy residue. My only complaint is it didn't give a true hydrating feeling if used alone. It helped control my breakouts but I also noticed this is a cream I couldn't use everyday. After a few consecutive days, I would have a small bump or two pop up. When I used it periodically, my skin responded well.

This cream is really amazing, I am really impressed with the results. Right after applying it I noticed my skin is more hydrated and plump. After using it everyday for some time now, I noticed my skin looking healthier and I did not have any breakouts. It's not greasy and it's amazing under makeup. I really recommend it to everyone looking for a moisturizer that does what it says it does. Complimentary from First Aid Beauty.

This nighttime cream works wonders for me. It's incredibly hydrating and has helped fade my hyperpigmentation. After using it for a few weeks, my skin appears much more even, and my fine lines are noticeably smoother. It has no overpowering scent and performs great overall. Gifted from FAB.

The FAB Firming Cream features a rich, velvety texture that absorbs effortlessly into the skin. Its creamy, moisturizing formula helps soften and plump the skin, promoting a healthier-looking complexion. Housed in an elegant glass jar, it offers a luxurious skincare experience. Gifted by FAB.

avis.titre: Great for fine lines and dark spots
avis.texte: This cream is both gentle and effective. It helps to make my skin look and feel more youthful. I have combination skin and it doesn't clog my pores. Rather, my skin feels healthy and fine lines are reduced. The niacinamide helps to brighten. This is perfect since I have some dark spots. The firming effect occurs over time in my case. I love this cream!
I love this firming cream so much. It is very effective and makes my skin so soft, smooth and hydrated . My fine wrinkles are less noticeable. I highly recommend this cream to everyone.

I bought this a week ago and use many other First Aid Beauty products. This burned, made my skin red, and break out. I've never had such a bad reaction before. I'm disappointed that this doesn't work for me.

avis.titre: Great but you might need to introduce it slowly.
avis.texte: The first time I tried this moisturizer I really did not like it because it broke me out. I'm pretty sure I made the mistake of accidentally combining it with a niacinamide containing serum that first time and my skin was just like "whoa too much niacinamide!" I gave it time to heal and tried it again, this time making 100% sure I did not combine it with any other niacinamide containing products and it went MUCH better. No break outs, just moisturized skin! Love it!
Love the richness of this cream! Its hydrating and it isnt greasy at all. Soaks into the skin right away. Great barrier cream that isnt as thick as others

FAB beauty just knows How to make Products, this Feels Like butter on my skin. Glides so nice and absorbs so well. Has No scent and Doesn't feel sticky at all. I feel my skin is Plumped and bouncy. I've been using this Under makeup to make my the results of makeup more smooth pf fine lines, it's wonderful.

avis.titre: Lightweight moisturizer visibly reduces fine line & wrinkles
avis.texte: First Aid Beauty Firming Cream with Peptides, Niacinamide + Collagen has been a great new product added to my skincare routine. Have been a longtime Ultra repair user. I am noticing visible differences with my skin with this product. It is helping to maintain moisture as well as visibly reduce fine lines and wrinkles. The moisturizer is lightweight and goes easily

This cream has been absolutely a life saver for my skin during these dry, cold winter months! I tend to have dry skin and this hasy skin feeling and looking amazing. It has a beautiful rich and luxurious texture without being heavy on my skin. It absorbs into my skin really well leaving it hydrated and nourished. I highly recommend it!

My dry skin has been LOVING this cream. I have been using it as the last step in my nighttime skincare routine. I always try to grab moisturizers that contain peptides so I was very excited to see this from First Aid Beauty. I loved the texture and found this cream to be just as moisturizing and effective as other creams I have tried that cost mode than double. Great value for this product!
I absolutely love this product! I only use it at night to make it last longer but still see skin improvements! I will always buy this

First Aid Beauty Firming Cream with Peptides Niacinamide + Collagen feels like a spa day for my skin. The Peptides, Niacinamide, and Collagen work together to retain moisture, plump and brighten, minimizes the look of pores, fine lines, and wrinkles. After using this product for a few weeks, my skin is super hydrated, smooth, and has a healthy looking glow. This firming cream has a medium thick texture and is concentrated, so a little goes a long way. I really like how fast it absorbs and it does not leave behind a greasy residue. It is Dermatologist Tested, does not have Artificial Fragrances, is Non-Comedogenic, and is great for All Skin Types (including sensitive skin) I am excited to see and feel more improvements with continued use. I very highly recommend First Aid Beauty Firming Cream with Peptides Niacinamide + Collagen.

This is my 1st time trying this Firming Cream. I really like the craminess of the whipped cream. It goes on light and blends in easily. No oily or greasy feeling. Leaves my skin feeling moisutized with some plumpness. I have no irritaion at all. Overall a great product that I will continue to use.
This cream is suepr hydrating and I love that it truly does seem to make my skin look and feel much more youthful.

This firming cream feels rich yet absorbs well without leaving a greasy residue. My skin feels soft and hydrated after applying, and I love the added peptides and niacinamide for extra nourishment. It gives my skin a nice, healthy look and wears well under makeup. Definitely a great addition to my routine!

I implemented this cream into my nighttime routine and my skin really likes it! Since the formula has thicker texture it works better for me at night. It feels very hydrating and plumping. I'm hoping with longer uses I will see some firming effects since this cream has so many beneficial ingredients. Definitely worth trying.

This First Aid Beauty Firming Cream with Peptides, Niacinamide + Collagen is creamy and rich. It applies easily. It absorbs really well. It doesn't leave my skin feeling oily or greasy after I've applied it. I can see a difference in my skin already. It helps to firm my skin and it's very hydrating. It leaves my skin feeling soft and smooth. It also doesn't cause me to have any irritation, redness or breakouts.

avis.titre: I will keep buying it!! Love it!
avis.texte: I use it every morning and evening. It makes my face look healthier and younger. I will continue to use !

avis.titre: I would make this my new staple!
avis.texte: I've been using this for a while now and I'm really impressed with the results! The texture is rich but absorbs quickly without feeling greasy. It provides great hydration, making my skin feel soft and plump throughout the day. I love that it contains peptides, niacinamide, and collagen—such a great combination for improving skin elasticity and overall appearance. I've noticed my skin looks firmer and smoother, especially around my jawline and cheeks. The fragrance is mild and pleasant, which is a plus for me. Definitely a great addition to my routine! Would recommend to anyone looking for a nourishing, firming moisturizer.

Gifted by First Aid Beauty. I have been using this morning and night. It's incredibly hydrating without feeling heavy. I have normal to dry skin. I feel that this would work well with all skin types. The formula contains peptides, niacinamide, and collagen. My skin looking smooth and plump. It layers well with other products. It doesn't pill, and works well with my sensitive skin. Definitely recommend!

I've been testing the new First Aid Beauty Firming Cream, and it's a solid addition to my skincare routine. The texture is rich yet absorbs quickly without feeling greasy, making it great for both morning and night. The peptides and collagen give my skin a nice plumpness, while niacinamide helps even out tone and refine texture over time. It's deeply hydrating but lightweight enough to layer under other products. While I haven't seen drastic firming effects yet, my skin feels smoother and more nourished with consistent use. Definitely a great option for those looking for an everyday firming boost!

This firming cream is a solid pick if you want smoother, bouncier skin! Its packed with peptides and niacinamide, which help with fine lines and gives your skin a more youthful look. The texture is rich, but not greasy, and it absorbs nicely. Plus, its free from a ton of common allergens, so its great for sensitive skin. Gifted by First Aid Beauty.
